title: Risk orchestration and comms matrix for vNext API rollout
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: coordinate cross-functional risk mitigation, rollout blockers, rollback playbooks, and standardized incident/launch comms for the vNext public API release. This ticket centralizes the decision matrix and step-by-step actions for pre-launch gates, go/no-go signals, and communication templates for internal and external stakeholders.

Scope: release blockers (SLO regressions, data-plane errors, auth regressions), roll-forward and rollback options, owner roster for launch-hours, escalation path, public-facing release notes cadence, and templated incident messages.

Primary deliverables: 1) Risk & comms matrix spreadsheet (owners, severity thresholds, automated checks), 2) Final rollback playbook with verification steps, 3) Internal and external incident/launch message templates, 4) Release notes checklist and publication schedule, 5) Post-launch monitoring dashboard links and on-call rotations.
acceptance_criteria:
- Matrix completed with named owners for each risk row and SLO thresholds defined.
- Rollback playbook validated in dry-run with infra and runtime teams.
- Incident and launch comms templates reviewed and approved by Legal, Security, and Support.
- Release notes draft published to the customer portal and scheduled.
- On-call rotation and escalation path posted to #oncall and included in the runbook.

rollback_summary: Primary rollback is a version pin to api-2026.02 across all serving pools with automated traffic migration to a safe model variant. Steps: 1) Pause new traffic in Router -> 2) Gradually shift all routed requests to api-2026.02 using traffic manager (validate token continuity) -> 3) Run smoke tests (end-to-end generation, embeddings sampling) -> 4) Re-enable normal traffic if green, else escalate to SRE lead. Dry-run verification steps documented in the runbook link above.
incident_comms_templates: Internal-Short: [SEV LEVEL] vNext API - Incident detected - Owner: {owner} - ETA initial triage: 15m - Channel: #incident-vnext

External-Incident: Subject: Service degradation for vNext API
Message: We are investigating a service disruption affecting the vNext API that may impact request latency and request failures. Our engineers are actively working on mitigation. We will provide updates at regular intervals and post a final root cause analysis. If you rely on dedicated/private deployments, please contact your account team for tailored guidance.

Message: Today we are opening early access to the vNext API. For full release notes, SDK changes, and migration tips see: {release_notes_link}. If you see unexpected behavior, open a ticket at support.redwood.com and include request ids and timestamps.
release_notes_plan: - Draft by 2026-03-16 (PM) -> Legal review by 2026-03-17 -> Marketing sign-off 2026-03-18 -> Publish and pin to customer portal on 2026-03-20 at 09:00 PT. Notes include breaking changes, migration steps, SDK changelog, and feature flags for opt-in.
risks_and_mitigations: SLO regression during first hour: mitigation: enable traffic shaping and degrade to low-cost model variant; alert threshold set at 1.5x baseline latency for 5m.
Auth token errors at scale: mitigation: enable token cache bypass and monitor token service error budget; rollback to prior release if error rate > 3% for 10m.
Data-plane errors on Dedicated customers: mitigation: route Dedicated customers to isolated pool; notify account teams immediately and prepare hotfix pipeline.
Release notes miscommunication: mitigation: concurrent staging publish to docs site + final Marketing sign-off; legal holds required for regulated customers.
